written.description: Gives an agent a browser that controls its own network traffic, so the model can capture, edit, replay and compare the requests a web app sends without a proxy in between. Each session runs under a network policy and records every fetch it allowed or refused.

alive.last_commit_message:
h5i app extract: write schema!'s Lean when schema = true (#702)

* h5i app extract: write schema!'s Lean when schema = true

`extract` only ran Charon and Aeneas, so the `lean "..."` file that
`schema!` renders (Schema.lean by convention) was written only by running
the kernel's test with H5I_APP_BLESS=1, which nothing documented. With
`schema = true`, `extract` now runs that test (release), and `extract
--check` catches a stale or missing schema file through the existing
restore-and-compare in check_fresh. `mutate` keeps extracting the kernel
only, since its edits never reach a `schema!` body.

* regenerate the man page and /manual/ for the extract change
